CERTIORARI -- SUMMARY DISPOSITIONS
25-442
ROYBAL, SHERIFF, ET AL. V. GRIFFITH, DARLENE
  The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted.  The
judgment is vacated, and the case is remanded to the United
States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit for further
consideration in light of West Virginia v. B. P. J., 609 U. S.
 958 (2026), and United States v. Skrmetti, 605 U. S. 495 (2025).
25-1348
HARRINGTON, PATRICK, ET AL. V. MARTIN, RANDALL
  The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted.  The
judgment is vacated, and the case is remanded to the United
States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit for further
consideration in light of Zorn v. Linton, 607 U. S. 568 (2026).
26-5123
CID, HEIDI V. UNITED STATES
  The motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma
 pauperis and the petition for a writ of certiorari are granted.
The judgment is vacated, and the case is remanded to the United
States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit for further
consideration in light of Hunter v. United States, 608 U. S. 713
 (2026).
